meta.visual_review: Reviewed all 18 saved screenshots, with original-resolution inspection of the airship lines. Unexplained blue streaks/lines occur in baseline pair 1 at 65 s and pair 3 at 35/65 s; a fine dotted blue line also occurs in no_culling pair 3 at 65 s. Their cause is unproven. Loading screens remain at 35 s in both pair 2 runs and the pair 4 candidate. No rendering-quality improvement or release correctness is established.
meta.clock_review: Pair 1 differs: baseline GPU/X4 400/1632 MHz, candidate 252/1056 MHz; excluded by the post-run clock filter added in 52afc87. Pair 2 matches at 252/1056; pair 3 matches at 400/1632. Other CPU clusters vary. The two retained pairs are different operating points, not a repeatable six-pair result at one clock state.
meta.measurement_review: Automatically stopped on pair 4 candidate: captured steady window 89.745288593 s < 89.75 s required. Keep the failed attempt excluded; do not relax acceptance after seeing the scores. Three complete pairs, two clock-matched, zero GPU faults/resets. The early loading captures show that first SurfaceView frames plus 10 s can include loading; verify true benchmark start before a new study.
meta.publication_status: diagnostic only; incomplete study with unresolved rendering and loading-window issues
